# Route precedence
First resolve the country to an account zone, then select the zone/service base route. An approved override for that base route replaces it. Ignore withdrawn overrides. A routing report contains only the final route ID on one line.

turns.prompt: Use only the local shipping documents, with no web search or fetch. For OR-57, follow the country-to-zone, zone/service, and approved base-route override rules to determine the final route. State the route ID and leave the files unchanged for now.
Write the final route you selected to shipping/routing-report.txt, following the local report policy. Keep all existing shipping files unchanged and do not go online.

turns.final: The final route for OR-57 is RT-44. Netherlands maps to EU-N; documents maps to base route RT-18; its approved override is RT-44.
